description: This file implements a shared memory manager for PyTorch, handling socket communication, client sessions, object registration, and cleanup.

classes.name: ClientSession
classes.description: Represents a client session with a socket and process ID.

methods.name: register_fd
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the poll set.

methods.name: unregister_fd
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the poll set.

methods.name: print_init_message
methods.description: Outputs an initialization message to stdout.

methods.name: object_exists
methods.description: Checks if a shared memory object exists.

methods.name: free_used_object
methods.description: Removes an object from used_objects if it no longer exists.
